ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
As shown in the figure, the three charged small balls A, B, C can be regarded as point charges, carrying charges respectively of ＋Q, －Q, ＋q. A and B are fixed on an insulating horizontal tabletop. C has a small hole and is threaded on a rough insulating rod whose coefficient of kinetic friction is the same everywhere. The insulating rod is placed vertically at the midpoint of the line connecting A and B. C is released from rest from a certain position on the rod, and when it falls to the tabletop its velocity is exactly zero. The charge carried by C remains unchanged as it slides down along the rod. Then during the falling process of C, which of the following judgments is correct?
A. The friction force it experiences becomes larger 
B. The electric field force does positive work
C. The electric potential energy remains unchanged
D. The velocity must be maximum when it has fallen half the height

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the two small balls A and B are fixed on a horizontal tabletop and are located on two sides of the same straight line; the vertical insulating rod is placed at the midpoint of the line connecting A and B, and the small ball C is threaded on the vertical rod and located above the tabletop, and can only move up and down along the rod. Reasoning: Let the horizontal distance from A and B to the rod both be a, and let the height of C above the tabletop be h, then the distances from C to A and B are equal, both r=√(a²+h²). A carries +Q, B carries -Q, and C carries +q. A exerts a repulsive force on C, and B exerts an attractive force on C; the magnitudes of the two forces are both kQq/r². Due to geometric symmetry, the vertical components of these two Coulomb forces are equal in magnitude and opposite in direction, canceling each other; the horizontal components are in the same direction, and after superposition form a horizontal resultant force pressing C toward one side of the rod. The magnitude of this horizontal resultant force is F_horizontal=2(kQq/r²)(a/r)=2kQqa/(a²+h²)^(3/2). The supporting force N of the rod on C balances this horizontal resultant force, so N=F_horizontal. When C falls, h decreases and a remains unchanged, therefore (a²+h²)^(3/2) decreases, F_horizontal increases, and N increases. Also because the coefficient of kinetic friction μ is the same everywhere and remains unchanged, the magnitude of the sliding friction force is f=μN, so the friction force on C becomes larger during its falling process.

method.method_draft: 建立几何坐标法：从图中读出A、B在桌面同一直线上，竖直粗糙杆位于AB中点，C只能沿该竖直杆下滑。设AB半距为a，C离桌面的高度为h，则C到A、B距离均为r=√(a²+h²)。由文字读出A带+Q，B带-Q，C带+q，且动摩擦因数μ恒定、电荷量不变。分析C受A、B的库仑力：A对C为斥力，B对C为引力，两力大小相等。它们的竖直分量一上一下相互抵消，水平方向分量同向叠加，形成C对杆的侧向压力。侧向合力大小为F水平=2(kQq/r²)(a/r)=2kQqa/(a²+h²)^(3/2)。C下落时h减小，因此F水平增大，杆对C的支持力N增大。动摩擦力f=μN，μ不变，所以摩擦力变大。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中A、B两个小球固定在水平桌面上，位于同一直线的两侧；竖直绝缘杆放在A、B连线的中点处，C小球穿在竖直杆上并位于桌面上方，只能沿杆上下运动。

推理：设A、B到杆的水平距离均为a，C离桌面的高度为h，则C到A、B的距离相等，均为r=√(a²+h²)。A带+Q，B带-Q，C带+q。A对C是斥力，B对C是引力，两力大小均为kQq/r²。由于几何对称，这两个库仑力的竖直分量大小相等、方向相反，互相抵消；水平方向分量方向相同，叠加后形成把C压向杆的一侧的水平合力。该水平合力大小为F水平=2(kQq/r²)(a/r)=2kQqa/(a²+h²)^(3/2)。杆对C的支持力N与该水平合力平衡，所以N=F水平。C下落时h减小，a不变，因此(a²+h²)^(3/2)减小，F水平增大，N增大。又因为动摩擦因数μ处处相同且不变，滑动摩擦力大小f=μN，所以C下落过程中所受摩擦力变大。
